chunks: Do not say of any thing: 'I will do it tomorrow,'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about saying 'I will do this tomorrow'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) to illustrate the balance between human agency and divine decree, emphasizing that 'Insha'Allah' is not merely a phrase but a theological acknowledgment of God's ultimate control over time. Scholars note that it serves as a practical reminder to maintain humility and avoid arrogance in one's plans, a virtue highly prized in the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings on daily conduct.
